subject: Temporary throughput headroom & staged pricing for BrightWave launch
messages:
From: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@brightwave.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightwave.com, Tom Riddell <tom@brightwave.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: capacity request for 9/2 campaign launch

Hi Laura,

We discovered an upward revision to our September 2 campaign forecast — expected inference volume for the launch window (Sept 2-4) is ~3x our current steady-state QPS for roughly 48 hours. This is a hard date for us and involves third-party ad joins; we need headroom to avoid throttling.

Can Redwood provide a provisional throughput lift for that window? We are flexible on structure but need clarity on:
- How quickly you can enable a temporary uplift
- Whether there are overrun surcharges and how they’re calculated (per-token or per-QPS)
- Any credits you offer if we commit to a higher reserved tier post-launch

Attaching our May–June usage export so you can see baseline.

Thanks — cc'ing Tom (engineering) and procurement to keep them in the loop.

— Alyssa
Alyssa Kim
Head of Product Ops, BrightWave Media
Attachment: BrightWave_usage_May-Jun.csv (csv)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@brightwave.com>
Cc: Tom Riddell <tom@brightwave.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Aug 2025 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: capacity request for 9/2 campaign launch

Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads up and the file. We can absolutely support a short, high-throughput window; below are two pragmatically different paths so you can pick what fits BrightWave's risk tolerance and procurement timeline: 

Option A — Temporary Uplift (fastest, PO not required if within X spend):
- Up to 3x baseline QPS for a 72-hour rolling window; enablement within 24 hours
- Surge surcharge of 35% applied to per-token usage above baseline for the uplift window
- No long-term commitment; billing on next invoice

Option B — Provisional Uplift + Launch Credit (preferred economics):
- Same uplift capacity, enabled within 24 hours after PO or email approval
- Surge surcharge reduced to 25% if BrightWave signs a 3-month reserved-capacity addendum within 14 days post-launch
- We’ll issue a one-time launch credit equal to 30% of surge charges if you convert to a reserved commit (applies to first invoice after conversion)

Operational notes:
- We’ll need a short SOW (attached) and a PO for Option B to lock schedule and billing paths.
- For audits: SOC2 evidence and per-route token logs are available on request.

I’ve attached a SOW draft and a quick usage snapshot with a suggested uplift profile. If you're comfortable I can loop in Sales Ops to provision a temporary cap and draft the short addendum.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_draft_Redwood_BrightWave.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tom Riddell <tom@brightwave.com>
Date: Sat, 23 Aug 2025 14:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: URGENT: capacity request for 9/2 campaign launch

Laura / Alyssa —

Quick input from pricing: we can move the economics to be more favorable to BrightWave if they sign a follow-on reserved commit. Alternate commercial offer we’ve used successfully: 

Option C — Launch Partnership (reduced uplift surcharge + credit):
- Temporary uplift (same envelope) with 25% surge surcharge during the 48–72h window
- One-time launch rebate of 20% off the surge charges credited within 30 days of invoice
- If BrightWave agrees to a 6-month reserved tier within 21 days, we bump the rebate to 35% and apply a $10k account credit toward first reserved invoice

This reduces immediate cost for the customer while increasing the probability of a mid-term commit. We’d need Sales Ops to sign off on the $10k credit. Laura — can you confirm whether procurement timelines allow a 21-day conversion?

— Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: URGENT: capacity request for 9/2 campaign launch — Ops & billing details

Alyssa / team —

Quick ops note and confirmation on approvals:
- Sales Ops approves Option C with the staged rebate (25% surge surcharge, 20% one-time rebate) as long as BrightWave provides a PO by EOD Aug 26.
- If BrightWave signs a 6-month reserved commit within 21 days, Finance will bump the rebate to 35% and process the $10,000 account credit (applied to the first reserved invoice).
- For immediate enablement we can flip a provisional flag and raise the per-route cap within 12 hours of receiving a written approval (email from procurement counts).

Attached: simple fee matrix (table) and a DocuSign envelope will be generated when we have the signed SOW/PO. Please send PO to billing@redwood.ai.

Thanks — I’ll generate the DocuSign and route legal for the short addendum once we have a PO or confirmation of Option C.

— Dev Patel
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Thanks, all — BrightWave accepts Option C as described (temporary uplift with 25% surcharge + 20% one-time rebate) and will aim to convert to the 6-month reserved tier within 21 days. Procurement will send a PO by Monday morning (attaching a draft PO here). 

Next steps we need from Redwood:
- DocuSign link for the short SOW/addendum we can sign immediately
- Confirmation you will enable provisional uplift within 12 hours of our PO email
- Point of contact for billing to receive PO (cc'd billing@redwood.ai above)

Attaching our draft PO for your intake team. Looking forward to getting this enabled — the launch is priority for us.

Regards,
Alyssa Kim
Head of Product Ops, BrightWave Media
